## Revenue Growth: Sea vs. Grab (FY2024 and FY2025)

| Fiscal Year | Sea Revenue (US$'000) | Sea YoY Growth | Grab Revenue (US$M) | Grab YoY Growth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FY2024 | 16,819,866 (vs. 13,063,560 in FY2023) | **28.8%** | 2,797 (vs. 2,359 in FY2023) | 18.6% |
| FY2025 | 22,938,469 (vs. 16,819,866 in FY2024) | **36.4%** | 3,370 (vs. 2,797 in FY2024) | 20.5% |

**Conclusion:** Sea grew its revenue faster than Grab in both fiscal years.
- In FY2024, Sea's revenue grew ~28.8% year-over-year, compared to Grab's ~18.6% [Sea, FY2024, p.91; Grab, FY2024, p.128].
- In FY2025, Sea's revenue grew ~36.4% year-over-year, compared to Grab's ~20.5% [Sea, FY2025, p.95; Grab, FY2025, p.88].

Sea's acceleration was driven primarily by strong growth across its e-commerce (Shopee), digital financial services (Monee), and digital entertainment (Garena) segments, while Grab's growth was driven by its deliveries, mobility, and financial services segments, but at a comparatively slower pace in both years.
